text: The warning-fix landing adds an array-shaped SyncAccounts annotation around historical sync-account helpers. Current setState takes one SyncAccounts object whose calendars and addressBooks fields are arrays, and the body iterates those fields. Proposed manual documentation rule for this Account Hub contract: state the outer object shape and the array-valued fields separately. Passing JSDoc lint alone does not prove that a type describes the consumed data. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Document the actual single sync-account object rather than an array of groups
